7 · Anatomy (2x): menu status block, ··· dot, pull pill
Numbers are CSS px at 1x. Annotation colour is for the board only.
1 Icon 16: ClockIcon (web/ui.tsx), fgColor-muted. AlertIcon when a
problem leads: fgColor-attention (stale, low), fgColor-danger (failed, limited).
3 API line 13/20, 400, fgColor-muted, one line, ellipsis.
4 Reset line 12/18, 400, fgColor-muted, one line, ellipsis.
6 Block bottom: 1px borderColor-hairline, then the menu rows.
Padding 12 top, 16 sides, 16 bottom. Text column starts at x 40.
Dot: 10x10 disc, top 2 / right 2 inside the 44 .ph-iconbtn,
box-shadow 0 0 0 2px bgColor-inset so it reads on the button edge.
Same shape for every problem; the menu block names the problem.
aria-label "More, sync problem" while it shows.
Pull disc pill (1x), one per #37 state
API and reset lines, clock, pill text
